name: The Southern Earth Experience

evidence.note: Booking profile: self-described high-energy dance party band mixing rock, funk and disco; song list included.
Band site blends disco, funk and classic rock and lists the Oct 3 Salt Shack gig.
Salt Shack calendar shows Southern Earth Experience on Saturday, Oct 3 at 7 pm.

dancing.notes: Calls itself a high-energy dance party band and plays disco and funk staples (KC and the Sunshine Band, Wild Cherry, Commodores), so expect freestyle dancing.

description: New York City band first formed in the early 1970s and later reunited, mixing disco, funk and classic rock hits from the '70s.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). No evidence of partner hustle at their shows, so only freestyle is listed. Booking profile places them in Middle Village, Queens.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Website changed: the band's own contact page names www.SouthernEarthBand.com; the old bandzoogle subdomain in current blocks robots, so use https://southernearthband.com/. Phone and email are the founder Carl's, published on the band's EPK as the booking contact; the owner may prefer to show only the contact page. They do play Long Island (Salt Shack, Babylon, Oct 3, 2026) even though playsAt is empty. No photos recorded: the live photos on the site carry a photographer's corner watermark ('Dominick Totino Photography'), and the vintage 1970s photos show the members as young teens. The site also mentions a 'GreenpointMusic' YouTube channel that is not band-specific, so no YouTube is recorded.

logo.alt: The Southern Earth Experience logo: the word Southern in heavy black retro letters with the word Earth in red running down the side

evidence.note: Band site/EPK describes a New York City band blending disco, funk and classic rock, and lists an Oct 3 gig at Salt Shack in Babylon, Long Island.
Salt Shack (100 Ocean Pkwy, Babylon) lists 'Southern Earth Experience', live band, Sat Oct 3, 2026 at 7 PM.
Founders Carl Battista and Joe Caputo started Southern Earth as kids in Williamsburg, Brooklyn in the early 1970s and still lead the band.
Contact page gives a phone/text number for Carl and an email, and names www.SouthernEarthBand.com as the website.
The Bash booking profile lists Southern Earth as a cover band in Middle Village, Queens.
Shows the Facebook page and Instagram page.
